Artifact.description: Frozen input artifact, relative to the manifest directory.

sha256.description: Expected lowercase SHA-256 of the encoded bytes.

Candidate.description: A candidate's ordered stages, all measured against the resized reference.

stages.description: Processing order, for example Drupal then delivered Imgix image.

CandidateResult.description: One candidate's evidence or explicit error.

error.description: Missing, hash-mismatched or unusable candidate reason.

meets_policy.description: True only when every stage meets the score budget and delivery meets byte budget.

stages.description: All measured stages before any failure.

Manifest.description: Frozen sweep policy and its externally produced candidates.

candidates.description: Nonempty candidate list. Missing or malformed candidates prevent selection.

maximum_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of the delivered stage.

minimum_score.description: Minimum cumulative SSIMULACRA2 score for every stage.

original.description: Immutable original; never rewritten by the sweep.

viewing_conditions.description: Display, scale, viewing distance, background and review conditions.

encoder.description: Encoder and version, including settings other than quality.

pixel_policy.description: Must be normalized_srgb_opaque; profile/orientation normalization is external.

quality.description: Encoder-specific quality setting; no universal visibility interpretation.

StageResult.description: A measured processing stage. Scores are not additive across stages.

cumulative_butteraugli.description: Butteraugli distance from the retained reference, at 80 cd/m2.

cumulative_score.description: Quality against the retained resized reference.

incremental_butteraugli.description: Butteraugli distance from preceding stage, at 80 cd/m2; not additive.

incremental_score.description: Quality against the preceding stage (or reference for the first stage).

stage.description: Frozen stage declaration, including output hash.

description: Advisory sweep output. No visibility or approval assertion is made.

human_visual_review.description: Always pending; a numerical threshold cannot prove invisibility.

lowest_quality_candidate.description: Lowest final encoder quality meeting policy, only for one encoder/settings family.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact manifest bytes, assigned by the caller.

original_bytes.description: Exact bytes of the preserved original.

selected_candidate.description: Smallest measured delivered file meeting policy; null for incomplete sweeps.

title: Sweep
